notes: Identical prefab and texture bytes are merged; all origin paths are retained.
Unity previews adapt source particle settings and textures, not Unity shader execution.
Godot recordings use authored review captures. Raw per-frame QA sequences and engine caches are excluded.
Original source files are stored in the separate local archive; docs/source-inventory.json maps donor-relative paths to SHA-256 hashes.
Only VFX textures are shown in the gallery; unrelated textures required by source dependency closure are preserved in the original archive.
